cvEn:
Ilan Goren Vagner, son of Haya and Reuven, was born in Rehovot on 9 Heshvan 5701 (10 November 1940). After finishing high school, he was a member of Hanoar Haoved, the working youth movement. He was also a member of the Israel Aviation Club.

He studied at the Air Force technical school and completed his studies there. After his enlistment in the IDF, he was a trainee in a pilot course. He fell while performing his duties on 26 Elul 5719 (29 September 1959), and was laid to rest in the military cemetery at Kiryat Shaul.
